newsitem.title: USA: Mercury Mail gets $5.5 mln in financing.
newsitem.headline: Mercury Mail gets $5.5 mln in financing.

text.p: Mercury Mail said on Monday it has raised $5.5 million in a second round of financing.

The company said the money will help launch an aggressive advertising and marketing program, secure additional news and information sources for its e-mail information services and continue to add senior-level executives to its staff.

The Centennial Funds of Denver, Boulder Ventures and Telecom Partners, all of which participated in the initial round of financing earlier in the year, are participants in the second round, the company said.
SOFTBANK also joined the second round as an investor, Mercury said.
Mercury Mail is a free service that delivers news, weather, sports, stocks and entertainment information to individuals via e-mail.
